For this fast-growing Belgian company with various subsidiaries in Europe, we are currently looking for an accountant to join an experienced finance department.
 

In this role, you are in charge of a portfolio of projects at various stages of development. You will be responsible for all accounting, tax (in cooperation with an external accounting & tax consultancy) and administrative requirements.
 

The job is based in Olen.
 

 
 

Accountant – The Role:
 

- 
 Review the booking of various invoices (AP/AR/bank statements)
 

- 
 Prepare the month- and year-end closings, as well as the annual accounts
 

- 
 Prepare the monthly VAT return, as well at the corporate tax return
 

- 
 Regular reporting to the company’s Finance Manager
 

 

Accountant – About You:
 

- 
 You have obtained a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
 

- 
 You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar role
 

- 
 You are fluent in Dutch & English

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.	
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.	
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.	
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.	
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.	
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!
	
• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.	
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.	
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.	
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.	
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.	
• You have basic PC skills.	
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.	
• You speak good Dutch or English.

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specialized in storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company offers a wide range of services, including warehouse management, transport and distribution, packaging, quality control, and customs clearance.Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

This international company specializes in the production and supply of plastic components for the automotive industry, including injection-moulded parts for vehicles.

Jobomschrijving

For an international manufacturing company in the Aalst region, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician to help ensure the optimal operation of an advanced machine park.

You will work in a two-shift system:
	
• Early shift: 06:00–14:00	
• Late shift: 14:00–22:00
As a Maintenance Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and improving industrial machinery and technical installations. Thanks to your expertise, production processes remain reliable and downtime is kept to a minimum.

Your tasks and responsibilities
	
• Carrying out preventive maintenance on production machines, injection moulding machines and auxiliary equipment.	
• Troubleshooting electrical, mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults.	
• Carrying out corrective repairs in the event of technical breakdowns.	
• Analysing faults and looking for sustainable solutions.	
• Independently carrying out small technical projects and improvements.	
• Actively contributing to optimizations aimed at increasing the reliability and efficiency of the machine park.	
• Working closely with the production department to minimize downtime.	
• Working according to applicable safety, quality and environmental standards.	
• Helping to maintain a clean, safe and well-organized working environment.

You have a strong technical background and enjoy working hands-on.

In addition, you have:
	
• A technical qualification in Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, Automation or a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.	
• Experience in the maintenance and repair of industrial machinery.	
• Knowledge of preventive and corrective maintenance in a production environment.	
• Basic knowledge of PLC control systems is an advantage. If you have limited experience in this area, you will have the opportunity to develop this knowledge internally.	
• Experience with injection moulding machines is an advantage, but is not required.	
• A good command of Dutch.	
• The ability to understand technical documentation in English and/or German.	
• Strong analytical skills and a solution-oriented approach.	
• A hands-on mentality and a strong sense of responsibility.	
• Good team spirit combined with the ability to carry out interventions independently.
